description: Use this to see webhook sources on one inbox. Read-only; requires auth. Inputs: inbox_id (omit when this key is limited to one inbox). Returns {object:"list", data:[{object:"webhook_source", id, name, enabled, url_hint, signature, created_at, updated_at}]}. url and the signing secret are not included. Another inbox is HTTP 404 inbox_not_found.

inbox_id.description: Inbox id, username, or email. Omit it when this key is limited to one inbox.

name: cooper_webhook_source_list

outputSchema.description: Webhook sources on the inbox. Tokens and secrets are omitted.

data.description: Items on this page, in the order the tool description gives.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 time the object was created.

enabled.description: True when the object is active.

inbox_id.description: Inbox id (inb_…) this object belongs to. Null when it applies to every inbox.

object.description: Object type name, such as list, message, or thread.

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 time the object last changed.

url_hint.description: Last 4 characters of the receiver token.

object.description: Object type name, such as list, message, or thread.

title: List webhook sources
